camel_example: aliyun ocr-api RecognizeAllText --region cn-hangzhou --Type Advanced --version 2021-07-07 --method POST --force
description_en: Recognizes text in multiple image types through a unified OCR interface, including general text, personal ID cards, and invoices. You only need to specify the image type by using the Type parameter without switching to a different API operation
description_zh: OCR统一识别接口支持识别多种图片类型，包括通用文字、个人卡证、发票等。您只需要通过Type参数指定图片类型，无须更换接口
name: RecognizeAllText

parameters.help_en:
Specify either this parameter or the body parameter. Do not specify both or leave both empty.
The URL of the image. The URL can be up to 2,048 bytes in length. Base64 encoding is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和 body 字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超过2048字节，不支持 base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
Specify either this parameter or the URL parameter. Do not specify both or leave both empty.
The binary binary file. The maximum file size is 10 MB.
If you use HTTP to call the operation, place the binary binary file in the HTTP body for upload.
If you use an SDK to call the operation, place the image in the body of the SDK
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和 URL 字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大 10MB。
使用 HTTP 方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到 HTTP body 中上传即可。
使用 SDK 的方式调用，把图片放到 SDK 的 body 中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
The image type. This is a required parameter and only a single value can be specified.
For supported image types, see Supplementary description of request parameters.
For document and card images, if the actual image type does not match the specified Type, recognition fails
parameters.help_zh:
图片类型。必选参数，且为单选。
支持的图片类型请参考 请求参数补充说明。
请注意，对于票据卡证类图片，当图片真实类型和入参指定的Type不一致时，会导致识别失败
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the figure detection feature. If enabled, the FigureInfo field is returned. For the metric description, see the response parameters.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: The default value varies by image type (Type). For more information, see Supplementary description of request parameters.
The following figure types are supported:
    - blicense_title: business license title
    - national_emblem: national emblem
    - face: face
    - finger_print: fingerprint
    - signature: signature area
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when figure detection is required
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要图案检测功能。如果开启，会返回FigureInfo字段（详见返回参数说明）。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：不同图片类型（Type）的默认值不同，详见请求参数补充说明。
支持识别的图案类型如下：
    - blicense_title：营业执照标题
    - national_emblem：国徽
    - face：人脸图案
    - finger_print：指纹
    - signature：签名区域
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要识别图案时开启此参数
parameters.name: output_figure

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the QR code detection feature. If enabled, the QrCodeInfo field is returned. For the metric description, see the response parameters.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when QR code detection is required
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要二维码检测功能。开启后会返回QrCodeInfo字段（详见返回参数说明）。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false。
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要识别二维码时开启此参数
parameters.name: output_qrcode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the barcode detection feature. If enabled, the BarCodeInfo field is returned. For the metric description, see the response parameters.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when barcode detection is required
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要条形码检测功能。开启后会返回BarCodeInfo字段（详见返回参数说明）。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false。
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要识别条形码时开启此参数
parameters.name: output_bar_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the seal detection feature. If enabled, the StampInfo field is returned. For the metric description, see the response parameters.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when seal detection is required
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要印章检测功能。开启后会返回StampInfo字段（详见返回参数说明）。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false。
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要识别印章时开启此参数
parameters.name: output_stamp

parameters.help_en:
The coordinate format to return (points or rectangle).
points: four-point coordinates. rectangle: rotated rectangle.
By default, you do not need to specify this parameter, and text coordinates are not returned
parameters.help_zh:
返回坐标格式（points、rectangle）。
points：四点坐标；rectangle：旋转矩形。
默认不需要传此参数，不返回文字坐标
parameters.name: output_coordinate

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the coordinates based on the original image. The system automatically processes images (such as auto-rotation and image correction). You can specify whether the returned coordinates are based on the original image or the processed image.
true: Return original image coordinates. false: Return processed image coordinates.
Default value: The default value varies by image type (Type). For more information, see Supplementary description of request parameters.
Note: This parameter takes effect only when OutputCoordinate is not empty
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要返回原图坐标信息。 系统会自动对图片做处理（比如自动旋转、图片校正等），您可以设置返回的坐标口径，是“原图坐标”或“算法处理后图片坐标”。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：不同图片类型（Type）的默认值不同，详见请求参数补充说明。
请注意：仅当OutputCoordinate不为空时，设置此参数才有意义
parameters.name: output_oricoord

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to convert the recognized structured information into an Excel file link. Default value: not required.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
The file link is valid for one hour.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when needed
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要把识别出的结构化信息转成 Excel 文件链接（默认不需要）。
true：需要；false：不需要。
文件链接有效期为一小时。
注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要时开启
parameters.name: output_kv_excel

parameters.help_en:
When the image type is mixed invoice, VAT invoice, fixed-amount invoice, air itinerary, train ticket, VAT roll invoice, or general machine-printed invoice (Type=MixedInvoice/Invoice/QuotaInvoice/AirItinerary/TrainTicket/RollTicket/CommonPrintedInvoice), you can use this parameter to set optional features.
Specifies the page number of the PDF or OFD file to recognize. For example, if PageNo=6, the sixth page of the PDF or OFD file is recognized.
If this parameter is not specified or the value exceeds the total number of pages in the PDF or OFD file, the first page is recognized.
Default value: the first page
parameters.help_zh:
当图片类型为混贴票证/增值税发票/定额发票航空行程单/火车票增值税发票卷票/通用机打发票时（即Type=MixedInvoice/Invoice/QuotaInvoice/AirItinerary/TrainTicket/RollTicket/CommonPrintedInvoice），可通过本字段设置可选功能。
指定识别的 PDF/OFD 页码；例如：PageNo=6，则识别 PDF/OFD 的第六页。
如果不传此参数，或传值大于 PDF/OFD 总页数，则识别 PDF/OFD 的第一页。
默认识别第一页
parameters.name: page_no

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the table is handwritten.
true: The table is handwritten. false: The table is not handwritten.
Default value: false.
Note: This parameter takes effect only when OutputTable=true
fields.help_zh:
是否是手写表格。
true：是手写表格；false：不是手写表格。
默认值：false。
请注意：仅当OutputTable=true时，设置此参数才生效
fields.name: is_hand_writing_table

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the table is borderless or has only horizontal lines without vertical lines.
true: Borderless table. false: Bordered table.
Default value: false.
Note: This parameter takes effect only when OutputTable=true
fields.help_zh:
是否为无线表格或表格只有横线没有竖线。
true：无线表格；false：有线表格。
默认值：false。
请注意：仅当OutputTable=true时，设置此参数才生效
fields.name: is_line_less_table

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to output single-character recognition results. If this feature is enabled, the CharInfos field is returned in the BlockInfo field. For more information, see the metric description of the response parameters.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否需要输出单字识别结果。开启后，BlockInfo字段中会返回CharInfos字段（详见返回参数说明）。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false
fields.name: output_char_info

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the paragraph segmentation feature. If this feature is enabled, the ParagraphInfo field is returned. For more information, see the metric description of the response parameters.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否需要分段功能。开启后会返回ParagraphInfo字段（详见返回参数说明）。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false
fields.name: output_paragraph

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the row-based output feature. If enabled, the RowInfo field is returned. For the metric description, see the response parameters.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否需要成行返回功能。开启后会返回RowInfo字段（详见返回参数说明）。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false
fields.name: output_row

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to output table recognition results, including cell information. If this feature is enabled, the TableInfo field is returned. For more information, see the metric description of the response parameters.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when you need to recognize tables
fields.help_zh:
是否需要输出表格识别结果，包含单元格信息。开启后会返回TableInfo字段（详见返回参数说明）。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false。
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要识别表格时开启此参数
fields.name: output_table

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to export the recognized table results as an Excel file and return the result as a file URL.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false.
The file URL is valid for one hour.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when needed
fields.help_zh:
是否将识别的表格结果导出成 Excel，并以文件链接形式返回。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false。
文件链接有效期为一小时。
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要时开启此参数
fields.name: output_table_excel

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to export the recognized table results in HTML format and return the result as a file URL.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false.
The file URL is valid for one hour.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when needed
fields.help_zh:
是否将识别的表格结果导出成 Html 格式结果，并以文件链接形式返回。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false。
文件链接有效期为一小时。
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要时开启此参数
fields.name: output_table_html

parameters.help_en: When the image type is general text recognition (high-precision) (Type=Advanced), you can use this parameter to set optional features
parameters.help_zh: 当图片类型为通用文字识别高精版时（Type=Advanced），可通过本字段设置可选功能
parameters.name: advanced_config

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the ID card quality detection feature.
The ID card quality detection feature includes: whether the image is a recaptured photo, whether it is a photocopy, a completeness score, and an overall quality score.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when you need the ID card quality detection feature
fields.help_zh:
是否需要身份证质量检测功能。
身份证质量检测功能包含：是否翻拍，是否是复印件，完整度评分，整体质量分数。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false。
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要身份证质量检测功能时开启此参数
fields.name: output_id_card_quality

parameters.help_en: When the image type is ID card (Type=IdCard), you can use this field to configure optional features
parameters.help_zh: 当图片类型为身份证时（Type=IdCard），可通过本字段设置可选功能
parameters.name: id_card_config

fields.help_en:
The country name.
Supported countries: India, Vietnam, Korea, Bangladesh.
By default, you do not need to specify this parameter. The algorithm automatically determines the country.
Note: If you specify the country name, the response time of the operation is shorter
fields.help_zh:
国家名称。
支持的国家类型：India，Vietnam，Korea，Bangladesh。
默认不需要传此参数，算法自动判断。
请注意：如果指定国家名称，接口响应时间更短
fields.name: country

parameters.help_en: When the image type is international ID card (Type=InternationalIdCard), you can use this field to configure optional features
parameters.help_zh: 当图片类型为国际身份证时（Type=InternationalIdCard），可通过本字段设置可选功能
parameters.name: international_id_card_config

fields.help_en:
The country name.
Supported countries: India, Korea.
By default, you do not need to specify this parameter. The algorithm automatically determines the country.
Note: If you specify the country name, the response time of the operation is shorter
fields.help_zh:
国家名称。
支持的国家类型：India，Korea。
默认不需要传此参数，算法自动判断。
请注意：如果指定国家名称，接口响应时间更短
fields.name: country

parameters.help_en: When the image type is international business license (Type=InternationalBusinessLicense), you can use this field to configure optional features
parameters.help_zh: 当图片类型为国际企业执照时（Type=InternationalBusinessLicense），可通过本字段设置可选功能
parameters.name: international_business_license_config

fields.help_en:
The list of supported languages.
chn: Chinese, eng: English, ja: Japanese, lading: Latin, kor: Korean, sx: Handwriting, tai: Thai, rus: Russian, mys: Malay, idn: Indonesian, viet: Vietnamese, ukr: Ukrainian.
Note: You can specify multiple language parameters at the same time, separated by commas. Example: Languages="eng,chn,lading". However, if you are certain about the language type of the image, specify only one language parameter for better recognition results
fields.help_zh:
支持的语言列表。
chn：中文，eng：英文，ja：日文，lading：拉丁，kor：韩文，sx：手写，tai：泰文，rus：俄文，mys：马来文，idn：印尼文，viet：越南文，ukr：乌克兰。
请注意：可以同时传多个语言参数，用逗号分隔。例如：Languages="eng,chn,lading"。但如果您确认图片的语言类型，建议传一种语言参数，算法识别效果更好
fields.name: languages

parameters.help_en: When the image type is general multi-language text (Type=MultiLang), you can use this field to configure optional features
parameters.help_zh: 当图片类型为通用多语言文字时（Type=MultiLang），可通过本字段设置可选功能
parameters.name: multi_lan_config

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the table is handwritten.
true: The table is handwritten. false: The table is not handwritten.
Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否是手写表格。
true：是手写表格；false：不是手写表格。
默认值：false
fields.name: is_hand_writing_table

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the table is borderless or has only horizontal lines without vertical lines.
true: Borderless table. false: Bordered table.
Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否为无线表格或表格只有横线没有竖线。
true：无线表格；false：有线表格。
默认值：false
fields.name: is_line_less_table

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to export the recognized table results as an Excel file and return the result as a file URL.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false.
The file URL is valid for one hour.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when needed
fields.help_zh:
是否将识别的表格结果导出成 Excel，并以文件链接形式返回。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false。
文件链接有效期为一小时。
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要时开启此参数
fields.name: output_table_excel

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to export the recognized table results in HTML format and return the result as a file URL.
true: Enable. false: Disable.
Default value: false.
The file URL is valid for one hour.
Note: Enabling this parameter increases the response time of the operation. Enable this parameter only when needed
fields.help_zh:
是否将识别的表格结果导出成 Html 格式结果，并以文件链接形式返回。
true：需要；false：不需要。
默认值：false。
文件链接有效期为一小时。
请注意：开启此参数后，会增加接口的响应时间，请在需要时开启此参数
fields.name: output_table_html

parameters.help_en: When the image type is table (Type=Table), you can use this field to configure optional features
parameters.help_zh: 当图片类型为表格时（Type=Table），可通过本字段设置可选功能
parameters.name: table_config

Code.description_en: The error code. This field is not returned when recognition succeeds
Code.description_zh: 错误码（当识别成功时不会返回）

AlgoServer.description_en: The list of algorithm server information. This field is returned only when the value is not empty
AlgoServer.description_zh: 算法服务器信息列表（不为空时才返回此字段）

Content.description_en: The aggregated text content contained in the image
Content.description_zh: 图片包含的所有文字汇总

DebugInfo.description_en: The debug information. This field is returned only when the value is not empty
DebugInfo.description_zh: Debug信息（不为空时才返回此字段）

Height.description_en: The height of the original image

IsMixedMode.description_en: Indicates whether the image is of a mixed-paste type

KvExcelUrl.description_en:
The URL of the exported file after the structured information of card, certificate, or invoice images is converted to Excel format.
The URL is valid for 1 hour
KvExcelUrl.description_zh:
卡证、票据类型图片的结构化信息转成 Excel 格式后，导出的文件链接。
有效期：1小时

PageNo.description_en: The page number of the PDF or OFD file. The value starts from 1

SubImageCount.description_en: The number of sub-images contained in the image

SubImages.description_en: The sub-image information contained in the image

Angle.description_en: The clockwise rotation angle of the sub-image. Valid values: 0 to 359 degrees
Angle.description_zh: 子图顺时针旋转角度（范围：0～359度）

BarCodeInfo.description_en: The barcode information of the sub-image (returned when OutputBarCode=true)
BarCodeInfo.description_zh: 子图条形码信息（当 OutputBarCode=true 时返回）

BarCodeCount.description_en: The number of barcodes in the sub-image

BarCodeAngle.description_en: The clockwise rotation angle of the barcode (range: 0 to 359)
BarCodeAngle.description_zh: 条形码顺时针旋转角度（范围：0～359）

BarCodePoints.description_en: The four-point coordinates of the barcode (returned when OutputCoordinate="points")
BarCodePoints.description_zh: 条形码四点坐标（当 OutputCoordinate=“points” 时返回）

BarCodeRect.description_en: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the barcode (returned when OutputCoordinate="rectangle")
BarCodeRect.description_zh: 条形码旋转矩形坐标（当 OutputCoordinate=“rectangle” 时返回）

CenterX.description_en: The X-coordinate of the rectangle center point

CenterY.description_en: The Y-coordinate of the rectangle center point

Type.description_en:
The barcode type. The following types are supported:
Codabar
Code39
Code93
Code128
Type.description_zh:
条形码类型。支持的类型如下：
Codabar
Code39
Code93
Code128

BlockInfo.description_en:
The text block information of the sub-image.
Returned when Type is Advanced, General, MultiLang, Commerce, or HandWriting
BlockInfo.description_zh:
子图文字块信息。
当Type为Advanced、General、MultiLang、Commerce、HandWriting  时返回

BlockCount.description_en: The number of text blocks in the sub-image

BlockDetails.description_en: The text block details of the sub-image

BlockAngle.description_en: The clockwise rotation angle of the text block. Valid values: 0 to 359
BlockAngle.description_zh: 文字块顺时针旋转角度（范围：0～359）

BlockConfidence.description_en: The confidence score of the text block. Valid values: 0 to 100

BlockContent.description_en: The text content of the text block

BlockId.description_en: The text block ID. Numbering starts from 0

BlockPoints.description_en: The four-point coordinates of the text block. Returned when OutputCoordinate="points"
BlockPoints.description_zh: 文字块四点坐标（当 OutputCoordinate="points" 时返回）

BlockRect.description_en: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the text block. Returned when OutputCoordinate="rectangle"
BlockRect.description_zh: 文字块旋转矩形坐标（当 OutputCoordinate="rectangle" 时返回）

CenterX.description_en: The X-coordinate of the rectangle center point

CenterY.description_en: The Y-coordinate of the rectangle center point

CharInfos.description_en: The character-level information. Returned when AdvancedConfig.OutputCharInfo=true
CharInfos.description_zh: 单字信息（当 AdvancedConfig.OutputCharInfo=true 时返回）

CharConfidence.description_en: The confidence score of the character. Valid values: 0 to 100

CharId.description_en: The character ID. Numbering starts from 0

CharPoints.description_en: The four-point coordinates of the character. Returned when OutputCoordinate="points"
CharPoints.description_zh: 单字四点坐标（当 OutputCoordinate=“points” 时返回）

CharRect.description_en: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the character. Returned when OutputCoordinate="rectangle"
CharRect.description_zh: 单字旋转矩形坐标（当 OutputCoordinate=“rectangle” 时返回）

CenterX.description_en: The X-coordinate of the rectangle center point

CenterY.description_en: The Y-coordinate of the rectangle center point

FigureCount.description_en: The number of figures contained in the sub-image
FigureCount.description_zh: 子图所包含的图案数量

FigureDetails.description_en: The details of the figure information

Data.description_en: The figure data. This field is returned only when data is available
Data.description_zh: 图案数据（有数据才返回）

FigureAngle.description_en: The clockwise rotation angle of the figure. Value range: 0 to 359
FigureAngle.description_zh: 图案顺时针旋转角度（范围：0～359）

FigurePoints.description_en: The four-point coordinates of the figure. This field is returned when OutputCoordinate="points"
FigurePoints.description_zh: 图案四点坐标（当 OutputCoordinate=“points” 时返回）

FigureRect.description_en: The rotated rectangle coordinates of the figure. This field is returned when OutputCoordinate="rectangle"
FigureRect.description_zh: 图案旋转矩形坐标（当 OutputCoordinate=“rectangle” 时返回）

CenterX.description_en: The X-coordinate of the rectangle center point

CenterY.description_en: The Y-coordinate of the rectangle center point

Type.description_en: The figure type. Valid values: blicense_title, national_emblem, face, finger_print, and signature
Type.description_zh: 图案类型。为 blicense_title、national_emblem 、face、finger_print、signature 中的一种

FigureInfo.description_en:
The figure information contained in the sub-image (returned when OutputFigure=true). This is a dictionary type where the key is the figure type and the value is the information of figures of that type. The following figure types are supported:
blicense_title: business license title
national_emblem: national emblem
face: face
finger_print: fingerprint
signature: signature area
FigureInfo.description_zh:
子图包含的图案信息（当 OutputFigure=true 时返回）。字典类型，键为图案类型，值为此类型图案的信息。支持的图案类型如下：
blicense_title：营业执照标题
national_emblem：国徽
face：人脸
finger_print：指纹
signature：签名区域

KvInfo.description_en:
The structured information of the sub-image.
Structured information is returned for image types such as personal ID cards and receipts. For example, for an ID card image, this field contains information such as name and gender
KvInfo.description_zh:
子图的结构化信息。
个人卡证、票据等类型图片会返回结构化信息。例如身份证图片，此字段会包含姓名、性别等信息

Data.description_en:
The text content of the structured information. This is a dictionary type where the key is the field name and the value is the recognition result of the field.
Different image types (Type) have different structured fields. For details about the structured fields returned for each Type, see Supplementary description of response elements
Data.description_zh:
结构化信息文字内容。字典类型，键为字段名称，值为字段对应的识别结果。
不同图片类型（Type）的结构化字段不同。所有Type返回的结构化字段详见返回结果补充说明

KvCount.description_en: The number of key-value pairs in the structured information of the sub-image
KvCount.description_zh: 子图所包含结构化信息的键值对数量

additionalProperties.description_en: The description of the structured information detail Value

ValueConfidence.description_zh: 字段名称对应值的置信度（范围：0～100）
